outcome: Provider delivery preference for low-risk women
Perception of women's preferred delivery method
Support for a woman's right to choose her delivery method
Willingness to perform cesarean section on maternal request
cohort: Obstetrician-gynecologists and midwives who provide prenatal care and/or labor/delivery services at two public and two private hospitals in Argentina
finding: Despite the ethical debate surrounding non-medically indicated cesarean sections, there were high levels of support for cesarean section on maternal request, especially by providers in the private sector and obstetrician-gynecologists.
mod_finding: Providers in the private sector and obstetrician-gynaecologists were more willing than either providers working in the public/both settings or midwives to perform a caesarean section on maternal request.
